info.name: Shipyard · Nomi integration API
info.description:
Every endpoint of the Shipyard integration API (/openapi/v1/integration), plus the admin calls that create an integration and its keys.

Set `baseUrl`, run folder 0 (or paste an existing ship_int_ key into `integrationKey`), then work top to bottom. Scripts on key requests fill `orgUuid`, `publishId`, `deploymentId`, `webhookId`, `secretRef` etc. automatically.

request.description: Returns an access token for the admin calls in this folder. Saved to {{adminToken}}.

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.data && j.data.id) { pm.collectionVariables.set("integrationId", j.data.id); }

request.description: The full key is returned once. Saved to {{integrationKey}}.

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); const k = j.data && (j.data.key || j.data.token); if (k) { pm.collectionVariables.set("integrationKey", k); }

request.description: Saved to {{revealKey}}. Server-side only.

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); const k = j.data && (j.data.key || j.data.token); if (k) { pm.collectionVariables.set("revealKey", k); }

item.name: Link an existing org to the integration

request.description: Needed for orgs made in the dashboard before the integration existed. Integration keys never reach unlinked orgs.
201 first time, 200 after. Integration key only.

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.data && j.data.id) { pm.collectionVariables.set("orgUuid", j.data.id); }

request.description: Irreversible.
Removes every environment, the dev database and secrets. Irreversible.

Moves the app with all environments, secrets, dev database and history. Containers redeploy once to join the new org's network; URLs and data stay. 409 if the destination has an app with this key (send app_key) or a publish is running.
App-wide: works before any environment exists.

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.data && j.data.ref) { pm.collectionVariables.set("secretRef", j.data.ref); }

request.description: Environment-specific; wins over the app-wide value. The environment must already exist (publish first), else 404.
Refused while an env var uses it.
Use {{appUrlRef}} to get the dev DATABASE_URL, {{ownerUrlRef}} for the user's own login.
Attach a zip of the project as `source` (no node_modules/.git/.env). Omit it to re-apply a changed manifest to the last upload. 202 = build started, NOT live yet.

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.data && j.data.publish_id) { pm.collectionVariables.set("publishId", j.data.publish_id); }

request.description: status: running | succeeded | failed. Show the URL only when succeeded.
Copies the last manifest and source. Empty database, new generated secrets, own URL.
status, failure{step,phase,message,tail}, steps, logs, next_after. Poll with after=<next_after>.
Optional body {"deployment_id": "..."}. No rebuild; migrations are not undone.

item.name: 5b · Domain
item.description: Pick and change an environment's public address.

request.description: available:true, or available:false with reason taken|invalid and free `suggestions`. With app+env, the environment's own current name counts as available.
200 on success. 409 with `data.suggestions` when the name is taken or invalid; nothing changes.
The `secret` (whsec_…) is shown once. Add "org": "<org>" to limit to one org.
Oldest first; pass the last id as `after`. Kept 30 days.
